import requests
import pandas as pd

base = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GNS.TOTL.ZS"
params = {
    "date": "2001:2010",
    "format": "json",
    "per_page": 20000
}
resp = requests.get(base, params=params)
resp.raise_for_status()
js = resp.json()
# js[0] is metadata, js[1] is data list
records = js[1]
print(f"Fetched {len(records)} records")
```

Now I will transform the JSON to a DataFrame with Country Name, ISO3 code, Year, and Value.

```python
import pandas as pd

# Transform to DataFrame
rows = []
for r in records:
    country = r.get('country', {}).get('value')
    iso3 = r.get('countryiso3code')
    year = int(r.get('date'))
    val = r.get('value')
    rows.append({
        'Country Name': country,
        'ISO3': iso3,
        'Year': year,
        'Gross Savings (% of GDP)': val
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# Preview
print(df.head())
print(df['Year'].min(), df['Year'].max())
print(df['Country Name'].nunique())
```

Applying a heuristic filter to remove aggregates and keep only apparent countries. Then, pivot to country rows with Year columns for 2001-2010.

```python
import numpy as np

# Heuristic filter to exclude aggregates
bad_terms = ['area', 'countries', 'income', '&', 'OECD', 'Euro']
mask = df['Country Name'].str.lower().apply(lambda x: not any(bt in x for bt in bad_terms))
df_c = df[mask].copy()

# Keep only years in 2001-2010 and numeric values
df_c = df_c[(df_c['Year']>=2001)&(df_c['Year']<=2010)]
df_c['Gross Savings (% of GDP)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_c['Gross Savings (% of GDP)'], errors='coerce')

# Pivot to wide format
wide = df_c.pivot_table(index=['Country Name','ISO3'], columns='Year', values='Gross Savings (% of GDP)')
wide = wide.reset_index()
print(wide.shape)
print(wide.head())
```
